Command.Name: EUP
Command.Title: EUP Troubleshooting
Command.Description:
If you're having issues with EUP, try the steps below before asking for help.
**1. Game crashes during startup or opening EUP Menu** Try installing the [YMT Limits Adjuster](https://github.com/Lepoissongamer/YmtLimitAdjuster/releases/tag/V0.1.2-alpha). Keep in mind that this is a vibe-coded script and you should follow step 2 if it doesn't work.
**2. Remove Lines from dlclist.xml** Remove the following lines from your dlclist.xml; <Item>dlcpacks:/mpg9ec/</Item> <Item>dlcpacks:/patchdayg9ecng/</Item> <Item>dlcpacks:/mpsum2_g9ec/</Item> <Item>dlcpacks:/patchday27g9ecng/</Item> <Item>dlcpacks:/mpchristmas3_g9ec/</Item> <Item>dlcpacks:/patchday28g9ecng/</Item>
**3. EUP props missing from the menu** If you've installed props but they don't appear in the EUP menu, try installing [PedProp Limit Adjuster](https://www.lcpdfr.com/downloads/gta5mods/scripts/47179-pedprop-limit-adjuster/).
If you're still having issues after trying these steps, please let us know below.
